source_scope: Conditional analysis of the historical 246-measure domain; whole-cohort historical QC is not nested feature eligibility and public data are not globally unseen.

population.missing_participant_policy: refuse; no removal or silent denominator change

observational_unit: Label-independent observation features. Author known-category averages are inadmissible for unknown-category prediction; an authentic acquisition/derivation route is unverified.
estimand: Equal-participant balanced accuracy of the nested selected scalar-FC classifier for the declared primary benchmark endpoint, conditional on the supplied historical domain and source provenance.

metric.name: participant_mean_balanced_accuracy
metric.formula: For every participant, (TP_class0/N_class0 + TP_class1/N_class1)/2; average over all 94 participants.
metric.inference: descriptive; ten fold scores are not independent samples for a t test or confidence interval

folds.outer_assignment: round robin into ten folds; IDs outer-00 through outer-09
folds.inner_sort: SHA256(UTF8('meg-policy-v1|' + outer_id + '|inner|' + canonical_id)), then canonical_id, restricted to the outer training participants
folds.source: design.py creates the proposal; actual participant maps must be saved and independently admitted

estimator.family: one scalar feature, balanced L1 logistic, liblinear
estimator.model_selection: All supplied 246 measures; each candidate scored on exhaustive inner out-of-fold predictions with the primary metric. Exact ties retain externally frozen measure order. Refit selected candidate on all outer training observations.
estimator.training_weighting: Source-style balanced weights over training rows/classes; not equal-participant training influence when participants have unequal observation counts. Equal-participant weighting applies to selection and evaluation. Matched comparators must use the same declared training weighting.

required: Matched local-amplitude or power nuisance baseline on identical observations, endpoints and folds
Fixed Spearman connectivity anchor after verifying its membership in the actual246 roster
Source-mixing robustness with independently defined physical transformation
missing_definitions: Exact nuisance amplitude/power frequency band, spatial/time aggregation and feature schema are absent from the canonical contract
Authenticated label-independent and aligned FC/nuisance input observations are absent
Exact source-mixing transformation and acceptance criterion are not frozen
comparison_not_implemented.rule: Do not synthesize nuisance inputs from the FC columns or treat absence of comparator as improvement evidence

separate_future_condition.eligibility: Independently preconfigured candidate domain with train-fold-only QC; a separately versioned prospective condition, not silently substituted for the canonical246 scope

source_holds: Exact post-QC246-measure roster and its selection provenance
Exact94-participant biological identity and observation ledger
Canonical Zenodo15315238v1 vs current article18294156v2 selection: no silent upgrade
Corrected publisher supplement identity joined to selected held file by hash
Regional time series to FC extraction identity and numerical agreement
Lawful packet access, competent references, protected candidate execution and full resource qualification
root_review_required: Root may approve the proposal as construction design; only exact source/cohort/fold/feature and comparator admission can establish a frozen benchmark.

primary_benchmark_endpoint.other_endpoints: descriptive; not pooled into the primary benchmark endpoint

claim_limits: Measures face/object category decodability among consciously seen stimuli; not consciousness detection or a necessary/sufficient neural correlate of consciousness.
Directed region-pair feature orientation does not establish physiological or causal connectivity.
No adjudication of GNWT versus IIT follows from this component.
This primary benchmark endpoint is proposed after the paper, data and results are public. It is not an independent confirmatory scientific test on the same public cohort.
